name: Arcane Feedback
summary: Human priests are being called from Darnassus to Stormwind. At the Temple of the Moon, Priestess Alathea reluctantly honors the Alliance summons. High Priestess Laurena waits at the Cathedral of Light to prepare the acolyte for deeper instruction.

sections.title: A Reluctant Summons
sections.body: Priestess Alathea oversees visiting priests at Darnassus's Temple of the Moon. She honors the formal alliance between the kaldorei and Stormwind, yet distrusts human ways of magic and faith. For ten millennia, grief from the War of the Ancients has shaped the night elves' fear of arcane power. Even human divine rites trouble the clergy when radiant faith blurs with arcane workings.

sections.title: Return to the Cathedral
sections.body: Alathea honors the bond between the Alliance races and sends you to answer a recall from the Cathedral of Light. High Priestess Laurena has sent couriers across the seas to gather human priests for advanced training. In Stormwind, you leave Elune's moonlit groves for grand stone sanctuaries and the golden radiance of the Holy Light.

faq.q: Why does Priestess Alathea want me to leave Darnassus?
faq.answer: Priestess Alathea sends you home at the request of your Stormwind superiors, though human theology also troubles her. She distrusts arcane magic even when it touches divine practice, and gladly sends human acolytes back to their own cathedrals.

faq.q: Why do night elves distrust human priestly magic?
faq.answer: Night elves distrust human priestly magic because their culture carries grief from the Sundering, caused by reckless arcane spellcraft ten thousand years ago. Kaldorei worship centers on Elune. Her priestesses mistrust traditions that border on or use arcane power, even among allies who follow the Holy Light.
High Priestess Laurena leads the faithful at Stormwind's Cathedral of Light. She trains emerging human priests in the Holy Light as their power grows.

faq.q: What does this quest lead into?
faq.answer: Reporting to High Priestess Laurena begins your advanced training as a human priest in Stormwind. There you learn the discipline and blessings of human adherents of the Holy Light.

angles.text: As a priest, your return marks a threshold in your spiritual path. You see the sharp divide between Elune's sisterhood and the teachings of the Holy Light.
As a human, you return to Stormwind, home of the Church of the Holy Light. You leave behind the cloistered and skeptical kaldorei priesthood.
As a night elf, you see Priestess Alathea's wariness reflect the kaldorei fear that arcane tampering by younger mortal races could bring another disaster.
